description: List games in the library, optionally filtered by platform, genre, and/or is_installed. Sorted by title (case-insensitive).

is_installed.description: Optional filter: only installed (true) or only uninstalled (false).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of game summaries.

description: Retrieve the full game record by gid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full game record.

description: Add a new game to the library.

is_installed.description: Whether the game is currently installed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new game summary.

description: Delete a game from the library. Also removes its achievements and play sessions.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {gid, deleted: true, removed_achievements, removed_play_sessions}.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated game summary.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated game summary.

description: List achievements, optionally filtered by game_id and/or unlock state. Sorted by (game_id, name).

is_unlocked.description: Optional filter for unlocked (true) or locked (false) achievements.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of achievement records.

description: Unlock an achievement. Fails if the achievement is already unlocked.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated achievement record.

description: List play sessions, optionally filtered by game_id and/or ISO date range on started_at. Sorted by started_at ascending.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive lower bound ISO datetime.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive upper bound ISO datetime.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of play session records.

description: Start a new play session for a game. Sets started_at to now and updates the game's last_played_at.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new play session record.

description: End an existing play session by supplying its duration in minutes. Updates the game's total playtime and last_played_at.

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the session in minutes.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated play session record.

description: Return total playtime metrics for a game: both the stored game.playtime_minutes counter and the sum of its individual play sessions.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {gid, title, playtime_minutes, session_total_minutes}.

description: List all wishlist items, sorted by added_at descending (most recent first).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of wishlist records.

description: Add a game to the wishlist.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new wishlist record.

description: Remove an item from the wishlist by wlid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {wlid, removed: true}.

description: Search games in the library by keyword across title, platform, and genre.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching game summaries.

description: Return game library statistics: totals for games, achievements, play sessions, wishlist, total playtime, unlocked/available achievement points, plus counts by platform and by genre.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a stats dictionary.
